entry_conditions: Work a LIMIT order to BUY the spread for $0.86 debit. Do not pay more than $0.94. Start at the mid and walk up a penny at a time; never buy at the natural ask.
Place the order between 10:00 and 15:30 ET. The first and last 30 minutes have the widest spreads and the worst fills.
